build_custom_build_hook: build a custom hatch build hook that sets infer_tag, platform, and pure_python in build_data
create_metadata_hook: create a hatch metadata hook that sets version, project name, and tensorflow optional dependency from environment variables
test_custom_build_hook_initialize: test the CustomBuildHook.initialize method to verify build_data is configured with infer_tag, platform, and pure_python
test_metadata_hook_update: test the MetaDataHook.update method to verify metadata version, name, and optional-dependencies are set from environment variables
review_hatch_build_hooks: review the hatch build and metadata hooks for dynamic package metadata and build configuration
